title: Ansel and the Thorn
author: Mara Dunmore
blurb: Quentin Blackwood, a royal food-taster building immunity one dish at a time, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must carry a secret that could reignite an ancient war, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
